sank.definition:
v fall or descend to a lower place or level
v cause to sink
v pass into a specified state or condition
v go under, "The raft sank and its occupants drowned"
v descend into or as if into some soft substance or place
v appear to move downward
v fall heavily or suddenly; decline markedly
v fall or sink heavily
v embed deeply

sanka.translation: 没有咖啡因的咖啡sans kaffeine (coffee without caffeine)

sankeys.translation: (Sankey 的复数) n. (Sankey)人名；(英)桑基

sankhya.definition:
n. A Hindoo system of philosophy which refers all things to
   soul and a rootless germ called prakriti, consisting of three elements,
   goodness, passion, and darkness.
sankhya.translation: n. [哲]数论派(一译"僧法派",古代印度哲学的一个派别)

sankt gallen.translation: n. 圣加仑（瑞士一城市）
